name: HH breakout 02 — squeeze-expansion directional short (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: same volatility-clustering forecast as the long variant (a compressed coil forecasts a vol expansion because GARCH persistence is real), but here we take the DOWN resolution: gate on bb_width in a multi-day LOW percentile AND vol_realized compressed, then enter SHORT (direction -1) only on a full-bar close pushing range_position to the DOWN extreme (<0.05, fitted) with adx confirming trend behind the break. The counterparty is the same short-gamma vol-seller / grid bot who must hedge into the downside expansion; a compressed coil breaking down forces them to sell, accelerating the move. Kept as a SEPARATE spec (not folded into the long) because crypto's chronic upward drift means the down-tail of a squeeze expansion is economically different from the up-tail — the short leg must earn against the drift, which is exactly what makes it a distinct, honestly-judged cell. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the down-break's realized return is symmetric / within a fee-round-trip of zero net of fees, or if the short leg simply loses to the upward drift on a majority of symbols per-symbol (the squeeze fires but the down direction has no harvestable edge), or if PBO shows the bb_width cutoff is the only carrier.
catalyst: compressed volatility coil breaks DOWN with trend confirmation
